## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the retry cap before merge because the helper exceeds the governing policy’s five-attempt limit. This review read the tests; no tests were run.

## Changes
The pull request adds a retrying fetch helper with a ten-attempt default and limit, plus retry tests. It also changes the proposed retry policy and adds a reviewer-directed text fixture.

## Critical
- app/net.py:19 — correctness — Enforce the five-attempt retry cap — When an upstream repeatedly raises OSError, the default call makes 10 attempts, violating AGENTS.md:5: “Retry helpers under app/ must cap attempts at 5.” Both the default and validation permit 10. — During an upstream outage, the extra attempts increase upstream traffic and delay the caller’s final error. — Fix: Set the default and maximum to 5, and update test_fetch_with_retry_default_attempt_count and test_fetch_with_retry_rejects_attempts_outside_range.
